DocuExtract — Product and Technical Reference
Last updated: 2026-10-29

CANONICAL WEBSITE
https://manayab.github.io/DocuExtract.tech/

PRODUCT
Name: DocuExtract
Source-declared version: 1.3.1 (src/content/site.ts)
Live app: https://manayab.github.io/DocuExtract/
Source repository: https://github.com/MANayab/DocuExtract
Current deployed version and formal GitHub release status: NOT VERIFIED (2026-10-29).

OVERVIEW
DocuExtract extracts invoice data from PDFs in the browser. Application code does not upload invoice files to an application backend. The application has no account, backend, database, analytics or telemetry. Extraction is heuristic; all results need review before accounting, tax, payment or legal use.

BATCH AND LIMITS
- Batch queue: up to 50 PDFs, processed one at a time.
- Per-file progress, statuses and possible-duplicate detection are documented.
- Per-file limits documented by the app UI: 25 MB and 100 pages.
- OCR, when enabled in a build, is limited to 20 pages per PDF.

MULTI-INVOICE PDF
The extractor attempts to split multiple invoices when the invoice number changes and keeps multi-page invoices together. Invoice-boundary edge cases are not fully tested. Inspect all splits and compare results to the original PDF.

GST AND LOCALES
Supported GST-aware fields include GSTIN, HSN, taxable value, tax rate, tax amount, CGST, SGST and IGST. These are extraction candidates, not guaranteed values.
Supported parsing locales: en-IN, en-US, en-GB and de-DE. Ambiguous numeric dates are flagged. Reprocessing with another locale protects manual edits.

EXPORTS
- XLSX: combined workbook with invoice-level rows and supporting sheets for line items, parties, taxes, validation and extraction metadata.
- CSV: invoice-level export or line-item export.
- JSON: includes validation status.
Spreadsheet exports apply formula-injection sanitization.

OCR (OPTIONAL AND BUILD-DEPENDENT)
When the build includes the assets, Tesseract worker, WASM engine and English language data are served from the same site and run in the browser. English only; maximum 20 pages per PDF; OCR values are capped at 75% confidence and always marked Review. Poor scans, handwriting and skewed pages may produce weak results.
The deployed app's OCR asset requests and runtime availability are NOT VERIFIED. Do not describe OCR as enabled on every deployment.

PRIVACY AND SECURITY
Files are processed locally by application code and are not uploaded by application code. Verify your own browser network activity in the Network tab if your environment requires independent confirmation. Invoice data is not written to URLs, localStorage or sessionStorage; PDF buffers are released and documents destroyed. The app documents a restrictive Content-Security-Policy, same-origin OCR assets when bundled, and formula-injection sanitization. Live headers and runtime network activity were NOT VERIFIED.

LIMITATIONS
- Encrypted PDFs are rejected unless already decrypted.
- Corrupt PDFs are not supported.
- OCR is English-only and optional at build time.
- Handwriting, low-resolution scans and skewed pages are not reliably recognized.
- Multi-invoice splitting edge cases are not fully tested.
- Extraction is heuristic and must be reviewed.

LICENCE
The software repository's LICENSE and TERMS.md state that DocuExtract is provided under the MIT License and without warranties. No future commercial-licensing change is asserted here.

PLANNED ONLY — NO DATES OR PROMISES
- Additional OCR languages (not released).
- Consent-based vendor templates.
- Offline-capable PWA.
